props.name: titleSource
props.comment: The field shown as the row title; the record representation when it is null or undefined.

props.name: subtitleSource
props.comment: The field shown as a second line when its value is not empty.

props.name: approverSource
props.comment: Record field holding the approver ids, a top-level key. Default `"approvers"`.

props.name: statusSource
props.comment: Record field the status is written to and read from. Default `"status"`.

props.name: pendingValue
props.comment: Status written while approvals are short of `required`. Default `"pending"`.

props.name: approvedValue
props.comment: Status written once approvals reach `required`. Default `"approved"`.

props.name: noteSource
props.comment: Record field the reason is written to. Default `"rejectionNote"`.

props.name: rejectedBySource
props.comment: Record field the rejecter's id is written to. Default `"rejectedBy"`.

props.name: requireReason
props.comment: Refuse a rejection until a reason is typed. Default `false`.

slots.name: extra
slots.comment: Rendered in each row, given the row's record.
